public_rationale: Yonhap reported that South Korea's KOSPI fell more than 8% during the morning of July 28, 2026 [e1]. That index movement does not establish material economic harm to at least 200 million distinct people while Altman and Amodei both remained billionaires [e1].
limitations: The packet contains no credible global count of distinct people materially harmed by an AI bubble unwinding.
It does not establish a completed episode with sufficient causal attribution.
It provides no contemporaneous wealth estimates for both individuals during a qualifying harm episode.
The forecast has no deadline. Missing evidence does not establish that it will fail.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The AI bubble will hurt hundreds of millions of people globally while Altman and Amodei remain billionaires.

statement.excerpt: So much of the so-called journalism around AI has been used to enrich the already-rich and inflate a bubble that will hurt hundreds of millions of regular people globally as Sam Altman and Dario Amodei remain billionaires despite their companies’ fates.

from_speaker: a bubble that will hurt hundreds of millions of regular people globally
Sam Altman and Dario Amodei remain billionaires
our_interpretation: Hundreds of millions means at least 200 million distinct people.
Hurt means material economic harm, such as employment, savings or pension losses attributable to the AI bubble's unwinding.
People must be counted without duplication; a dollar amount of market losses is not a population count.
Both individuals must retain personal net worth of at least US$1 billion during the relevant harm episode.
The normalized forecast is assessed here. The accompanying claim about journalism causing the bubble would require a separate causal assessment.
criteria.support_condition: Credible evidence establishes AI-bubble-related economic harm to at least 200 million distinct people worldwide while both named individuals remain billionaires during that episode.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A clearly identified and completed episode establishes an incompatible wealth outcome or a defensible affected-population total below the threshold. An incomplete count or absence of the event by the evaluation date is not contradiction.

evidence.explanation: Documents a substantial regional market decline associated in the report with concerns about AI investment. It does not measure affected people, establish global causal losses or report the two founders' wealth during the episode.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A documented AI-bubble episode, a credible unduplicated count of people materially harmed, and contemporaneous net-worth estimates for both individuals. Support requires at least 200 million people harmed while both remain billionaires. Contradiction requires a completed episode with a defensible count below that threshold or an incompatible wealth outcome during the same episode.
